rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH differential_expression_by_doid AS (
  SELECT
    gene_symbol,
    doid,
    log2fc,
    pvalue
  FROM differential_expression
),
healthy_expression_by_uberon_gene AS (
  SELECT
    ensembl_gene_id,
    uberon_anatomical_id,
    expression_level_gene_relative,
    expression_score
  FROM healthy_expression
),
diseases_with_uberon_tissue AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS disease_id,
    d.name AS disease_name,
    ct.uberon_anatomical_id AS cancer_tissue_uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM disease d
  JOIN cancer_tissue ct
    ON d.id = ct.doid
)
SELECT
  deb.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  'differential_expression' AS source_table,
  dwt.disease_id AS evidence_doid,
  CAST(deb.log2fc AS text) AS expression_metric,
  deb.pvalue AS pvalue_or_null
FROM diseases_with_uberon_tissue dwt
JOIN differential_expression_by_doid deb
  ON deb.doid = dwt.disease_id
WHERE (dwt.disease_name ILIKE '%lung%' OR dwt.cancer_tissue_uberon_anatomical_id ILIKE '%lung%')
  AND deb.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND deb.gene_symbol <> ''

UNION

SELECT
  xg.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  'healthy_expression' AS source_table,
  dwt.disease_id AS evidence_doid,
  COALESCE(he.expression_level_gene_relative, CAST(he.expression_score AS text)) AS expression_metric,
  NULL::double precision AS pvalue_or_null
FROM diseases_with_uberon_tissue dwt
JOIN healthy_expression_by_uberon_gene he
  ON he.uberon_anatomical_id = dwt.cancer_tissue_uberon_anatomical_id
JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xg
  ON xg.ensembl_gene_id = he.ensembl_gene_id
WHERE (dwt.disease_name ILIKE '%lung%' OR dwt.cancer_tissue_uberon_anatomical_id ILIKE '%lung%')
  AND xg.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND xg.gene_symbol <> ''

ORDER BY gene_symbol

rows.question: Show biomarker gene symbol and description for 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT b.gene_symbol,
       b.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT biomarker_internal_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(alias, '')) LIKE '%breast%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_breast_alias
  FROM biomarker_alias
  GROUP BY biomarker_internal_id
) a ON a.biomarker_internal_id = b.id
WHERE (
  lower(coalesce(b.biomarker_description, '')) LIKE '%breast cancer%'
  OR lower(coalesce(b.gene_symbol, '')) LIKE '%breast%'
  OR coalesce(a.has_breast_alias, 0) = 1
)
ORDER BY b.gene_symbol ASC

rows.question: What are the name of cancer types where the A1BG gene expression is significantly increased (up regulated)
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.name AS cancer_type
FROM differential_expression de
JOIN disease d
  ON de.doid = d.id
WHERE de.gene_symbol = 'A1BG'
  AND d.name IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(d.name) <> ''
  AND (
    LOWER(COALESCE(de.expression_change_direction, '')) LIKE '%up%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(de.expression_change_direction, '')) LIKE '%increase%'
  )
  AND (
    (de.adjpvalue IS NOT NULL AND de.adjpvalue < 0.05)
    OR (de.pvalue IS NOT NULL AND de.pvalue < 0.05)
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(de.statistical_significance, '')) LIKE '%significant%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(de.statistical_significance, '')) IN ('yes','true')
  )
ORDER BY cancer_type

rows.question: What is the test trade name for FDA tests which are actually used for predisposition?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fda_test_use_rows AS (
  SELECT
    id::bigint AS id,
    test_trade_name,
    test_submission,
    approved_indication,
    actual_use
  FROM biomarker_fda_test_use
),
biomarker_fda_test_basic AS (
  SELECT
    test_trade_name,
    test_manufacturer,
    test_submission,
    biomarker_origin,
    doid,
    histological_type,
    specimen_type,
    platform_method,
    test_number_genes,
    test_adoption_evidence,
    test_approval_status,
    test_study_design,
    clinical_significance
  FROM biomarker_fda_test
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.test_trade_name
FROM fda_test_use_rows f
JOIN biomarker_fda_test_basic b
  ON f.test_trade_name = b.test_trade_name
 AND f.test_submission = b.test_submission
WHERE f.actual_use = 'predisposition'

rows.question: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH disease_basic AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS disease_id,
    d.name AS disease_name
  FROM disease d
  WHERE d.name = 'breast cancer'
),
biomarker_core AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
    b.biomarker_id AS biomarker_external_id,
    b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
  FROM biomarker b
)
SELECT
  bc.gene_symbol,
  bc.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_core bc
JOIN disease_basic db ON true
WHERE
  bc.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM differential_expression de
    WHERE de.doid = db.disease_id
      AND de.gene_symbol = bc.gene_symbol
  )
ORDER BY
  bc.gene_symbol
